findings.description: Profile biography explicitly identifies ECE appointment as adjunct, despite generic secondary professor title in directory.

Checked ECE department home, about page and directory, the full college directory data across both primary and secondary ECE associations, and college 2023, 2024, spring/fall 2025, and 2026 hiring announcements. No distinct affiliate or courtesy roster was located and no additional ECE professors or incoming announcements were identified in these sources; all ECE appointees in the hiring announcements appear in the enumerated directory.
Directory and profile identify Scholar, not a professorial rank; classified as generic non-professorial affiliation without inferring a research, visiting, or other subtype.
